title: “I just chose words carefully”
summary:
The article highlights the challenges of achieving text justification in monospace fonts. While regular text and right alignment are manageable, centering is difficult without half-spaces, and full justification is particularly problematic. The large, uneven spaces created in monospace full justification lead to an unpleasant visual experience. Hyphenation, a common solution in other typesetting, also fails here as hyphens become overly conspicuous and disrupt copy-paste functionality, which explains why full justification is rarely seen in plain text files.

The article then presents an astonishing solution: manually rewriting text to precisely choose words that fill each line, thus avoiding any double spaces. This labor-intensive method was famously employed by "rs1n" in the late 1990s for his 17,000-word Super Metroid guide. Every line in the guide features a perfectly aligned right margin with no "twin spaces." When asked, rs1n explained, "I just chose words carefully so that everything lined up on the right hand side. Everything was done with an ASCII editor."

The author shares this as a curiosity, noting that while rewrites are common for print media to manage layout, they are unusual for onscreen writing. However, the meticulous effort resonates with anyone who has spent hours adjusting UI strings or tooltips to fit specific width constraints in crowded digital interfaces.
chinese_title: 我只是斟酌了用词。
chinese_summary:
本文阐述了在等宽字体中实现文本两端对齐的挑战。虽然常规文本和右对齐尚可处理，但没有半角空格的话，居中对齐就很难实现，而两端对齐则尤为棘手。等宽字体两端对齐所产生的大量不均匀空格会带来不愉快的视觉体验。连字符（在其他排版中常见的解决方案）在此处也失效了，因为连字符会变得过于醒目并破坏复制粘贴功能，这解释了为何纯文本文件中很少看到两端对齐。

文章接着介绍了一个令人惊讶的解决方案：手动重写文本，精确选择词语以填满每一行，从而避免任何双空格。这种劳动密集型方法在1990年代后期被“rs1n”用于他长达17,000字的《超级银河战士》攻略，并因此闻名。该攻略中的每一行都具有完美对齐的右边缘，没有“双胞胎空格”。当被问及此事时，rs1n解释说：“我只是仔细选择了词语，让所有内容都在右侧对齐。一切都是用ASCII编辑器完成的。”

作者将此作为一个奇闻趣事分享，并指出虽然为管理版面布局而重写文本在印刷媒体中很常见，但在屏幕写作中却不同寻常。然而，这种一丝不苟的努力，会引起任何曾在拥挤的数字界面中，为使UI字符串或工具提示适应特定宽度限制而花费数小时调整的人的共鸣。

title: AnkiDroid: Google Play no longer allowing Open Collective donation link
summary:
AnkiDroid, a popular free and open-source flashcard app with over 10 million installs, is facing removal from Google Play by September 11, 2026 (except in India and Russia). Google has rejected recent app updates due to AnkiDroid's use of an external link for donations, claiming the recipient organization is "not tax-exempt."

AnkiDroid relies solely on donations via Open Collective, its fiscal host, which holds a U.S. IRS 501(c)(6) tax-exempt status. Google's Payments Policy allows external payments for "tax-exempt donations," and AnkiDroid provided its 501(c)(6) determination letter. However, Google, whose policy example mentions 501(c)(3) organizations, subsequently stated AnkiDroid's donations are to an organization that is "not tax-exempt," without clarifying why 501(c)(6) status is deemed insufficient.

Although 501(c)(6) organizations are tax-exempt, donations to them are not typically tax-deductible for donors. AnkiDroid highlights that Google's communications explicitly refer to the organization's "tax-exempt" status.

To prevent removal, AnkiDroid is reluctantly removing donation links from its Play Store build under protest. They are seeking clarification from Google on their interpretation of "tax-exempt donations" and appealing for public assistance in reaching someone at Google who can help resolve the dispute.
chinese_title: AnkiDroid: Google Play 不再允许 Open Collective 捐赠链接
chinese_summary:
AnkiDroid是一款广受欢迎的免费开源抽认卡应用，安装量超1000万，但它正面临于2026年9月11日前被Google Play下架的风险（印度和俄罗斯除外）。谷歌因AnkiDroid使用外部链接进行捐赠而拒绝了其近期应用更新，声称接收捐赠的组织“不免税”。

AnkiDroid完全依赖通过其财务托管机构Open Collective获得的捐赠，该机构拥有美国国税局（IRS）501(c)(6)的免税资格。谷歌的支付政策允许外部支付用于“免税捐赠”，AnkiDroid也提供了其501(c)(6)认定函。然而，谷歌（其政策示例中提到了501(c)(3)组织）随后表示AnkiDroid的捐赠是给一个“不免税”的组织，但没有澄清为何501(c)(6)资格被认为不充分。

尽管501(c)(6)组织本身是免税的，但捐赠给它们的款项通常不能为捐赠者抵税。AnkiDroid强调，谷歌的沟通明确提及了该组织的“免税”资格。

为避免被下架，AnkiDroid正抗议并无奈地从其Google Play商店版本中移除捐赠链接。他们正寻求谷歌澄清其对“免税捐赠”的解释，并呼吁公众协助联系谷歌内部能够帮助解决此争议的人员。

title: OpenShot 4.0 – Open-source video editor
summary:
OpenShot 4.0 has been released, introducing significant creative workflow upgrades to the open-source video editor. A highlight is the **New Color View**, offering professional color correction and grading tools including color wheels, curves, LUTs, and live video scopes (Luma Waveform, Histogram, RGB Parade, Vectorscope) within a dedicated Color Grade effect.

The **New Recording View** transforms OpenShot into a capture and editing workspace, allowing users to record their screen, webcam, microphone, and system audio directly into a project, with each source kept separate and editable on the timeline.

Version 4.0 also brings **10 new effects**, such as Audio Visualization for animated graphics, Beat Sync for audio-reactive elements, Film Grain, Denoise Image, Shadow, Glow, Displacement Map, and Timer. A standout feature is **local AI-powered masks**, enabling users to isolate subjects with the new Object Mask effect using free, downloadable machine learning models that run entirely on the user's computer, without cloud services or subscriptions.

The **timeline has been redesigned** for a cleaner, native Qt experience, featuring smoother zooming, easier keyframe editing, and editable timecode. Performance has also seen notable improvements, with Blur being dramatically faster and general enhancements to Sharpen, timeline rendering, video scopes, and color grading. The update also lays a more modern foundation with expanded Qt 6 support.
chinese_title: OpenShot 4.0 — 开源视频编辑器
chinese_summary:
OpenShot 4.0 已发布，为这款开源视频编辑器带来了重大的创意工作流程升级。亮点是**全新色彩视图**，在一个专门的“色彩分级”效果中，提供专业的色彩校正和分级工具，包括色轮、曲线、LUTs以及实时视频示波器（亮度波形图、直方图、RGB分量显示、矢量示波器）。

**全新录制视图**将OpenShot转变为一个捕捉和编辑工作区，允许用户直接将屏幕、网络摄像头、麦克风和系统音频录制到项目中，并且每个源在时间轴上保持独立且可编辑。

4.0版本还带来了**10个新效果**，例如用于动画图形的“音频可视化”、用于音频响应元素的“节拍同步”、胶片颗粒、图像去噪、阴影、发光、置换贴图和计时器。一个突出功能是**本地AI驱动的蒙版**，用户可以使用新的“对象蒙版”效果隔离主体，通过免费、可下载的机器学习模型，这些模型完全在用户计算机上运行，无需云服务或订阅。

**时间轴已重新设计**，以获得更简洁、原生的Qt体验，特点包括更平滑的缩放、更简单的关键帧编辑和可编辑的时间码。性能也得到了显著提升，模糊效果速度显著加快，并普遍增强了锐化、时间轴渲染、视频示波器和色彩分级。此次更新还通过扩展对Qt 6的支持，奠定了更现代的基础。
